goal: One anonymous Ethereum chain identity input control before any Aave history or economic experiment
expected: Verified TLS followed by JSON-RPC eth_chainId result 0x1
observed: Python 3.14.8 raised SSLCertVerificationError before obtaining an HTTP response; no chain data received
root_cause: This macOS Python installation has neither a usable default cafile nor capath and its configured openssl directory is empty. macOS system curl verified the same hostname successfully (TLS verify 0, HEAD 405); Python with /etc/ssl/cert.pem also completed certificate and hostname verification, then received HTTP HEAD 403. The TLS failure is attributable to missing default trust roots. HEAD access outcomes differ; whether the required POST succeeds remains unproven and upstream policy cause is UNKNOWN.
evidence: Read-only environment: DefaultVerifyPaths(cafile=None, capath=None), configured /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.14/etc/openssl empty, certifi absent
System /usr/bin/curl HEAD same endpoint: http_status=405 ssl_verify=0
Python explicit /etc/ssl/cert.pem HEAD same endpoint: check_hostname=True verify_mode=CERT_REQUIRED, HTTP 403
next_action: Use the OS-managed CA bundle only when the macOS Python default roots are missing. Retain certificate and hostname checks. Gate authorizes the exact original chain command once; append its artifacts under tls-retry-once without overwriting failed originals. On any further failure stop and reassess, no third RPC attempt.
